_comment: Receipt verification vectors. Each case is checked against keys.json unless it carries its own 'keys'. 'expect' is the verifier status. Synthetic cases cover a revoked key, envelope fields that disagree with the signed payload, an advisory payload_hash that does not match recomputation (still verified when signed), a float-bearing payload that verifies without re-serialization, a genuine P-256 signature that is unsupported by receipt v0.1, and malformed bundles.
